representation.name: DBO
representation.scope: special monotone pairwise-variable-disjoint block object; NOT arbitrary DNF; NOT CNF
representation.canonical_stage: Phi_q=A OR T_1 OR ... OR T_(q-1) OR C_q

scientific_target: Certify exact existential projection/reconstruction/verification for the sealed BA20 arbitrary-finite-depth family in compact DBO form without materializing N_h=p*PRODUCT n_q prime implicates or intermediate Cartesian support products.

candidate_theorems.base: EXISTS x,y [AND_i(a_i OR x) AND (-x OR y) AND AND_j(-y OR b1_j)] IFF A OR C_1
candidate_theorems.block_lift: For R independent of b,t,z,c: EXISTS b_1..b_n,z [(R OR AND_j b_j) AND AND_j(-b_j OR t_j OR z) AND AND_k(-z OR c_k)] IFF R OR AND_j t_j OR AND_k c_k
candidate_theorems.block_lift_decomposition: EXISTS b [(R OR B) AND U] IFF R OR T OR z; then EXISTS z[(R OR T OR z) AND (-z OR C)] IFF R OR T OR C
candidate_theorems.full_state: Psi_q=Phi_q AND AND_{ell=q}^{h-1} SEED_ell; future seeds remain explicit until their level
candidate_theorems.restriction: DBO closed exactly under partial assignments by killing false-hit blocks, removing true literals, TRUE if any block empties, FALSE if all killed
candidate_theorems.witness: Any surviving DBO block can be completed TRUE; then BA20 reconstruction returns original source witness
candidate_theorems.all2: p=1,g=1,n_q=2: h+1 blocks, 2h+1 refs versus BA20 2^h auxiliary-free CNF clauses
